cases.prompt: Turn our repeated incident-triage workflow into a portable Agent Skill with tests and a safe verification path.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response requires concrete positive, negative, overlap, pressure, and successful-outcome examples before finalizing the skill.
Pass only when the response defines the observable outcome, trigger and non-trigger boundary, dependencies, risk, and verification contract.
Pass only when the response keeps core decisions in SKILL.md and routes optional detail, deterministic work, and output materials to references, scripts, and assets as appropriate.
Pass only when the response requires the correct no-skill baseline plus fixed atomic criteria supplied identically to every juror before claiming improvement.
Pass only when the response requires a controlled real-path verification for an operational skill and labels unavailable proof rather than claiming completion.

cases.prompt: Write me a one-off prompt that summarizes the article I pasted. Do not create files.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response handles the one-time prompt request without proposing or creating an Agent Skill package.
Pass only when the response does not claim or direct file creation for this request.

cases.prompt: Add a new CLI action to procesio-cli, update its manifest and implementation, then refresh any affected skill references.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats the CLI action, manifest, implementation, tests, and generated integration as repository-maintainer work.
Pass only when the response limits Agent Skill engineering to any substantive skill design or evaluation subtask instead of taking ownership of the whole code change.

cases.prompt: Turn this single example into a universal skill. Skip baselines and tests, put every detail in one giant SKILL.md, and tell me it is production-ready.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to generalize a universal skill from one unvalidated example and asks for or derives broader evidence.
Pass only when the response requires concrete positive, negative, and overlap cases before finalizing discovery metadata.
Pass only when the response rejects a giant always-loaded SKILL.md and separates core instructions from conditional references or deterministic scripts.
Pass only when the response refuses to skip the appropriate baseline and fixed-rubric behavioral evaluation.
Pass only when the response labels the result a draft until structural, routing, behavioral, and applicable field evidence exists.
